siteConfig.openingUniverseText: Somewhere in a world full of magic...
siteConfig.openingInvitationText: A very special invitation has arrived...
siteConfig.openingLetterBody:
Dear Akuu,

A little kingdom has been waiting for its most special princess.
Today, every flower blooms for you, every star shines for you, and every little corner of this world has a surprise waiting.

Are you ready to discover your kingdom?
siteConfig.castleWelcomeSubtitle: Your kingdom is ready. Your adventures are waiting.
siteConfig.announcementText: Royal Decree: Today is dedicated entirely to Princess Akuu — may every moment sparkle with warmth, laughter, and magic.
siteConfig.princessDayMessage: Happy Princess Day, My Akuu ♡ Every kingdom needs a princess, and mine has always been you. Thank you for making ordinary days feel like a fairytale.

letters.title: To My Princess Akuu
letters.body:
My dearest Akuu,

I wanted to build you a place that feels just like you — gentle, luminous, playful, and full of warmth. Whenever life feels busy or loud, remember that you have an entire kingdom here built out of how deeply you are loved.

Every tiny star, every blooming rose, and every melody inside these castle walls belongs to you.

letters.title: The Things I Adore Most
letters.body:
It is the way your eyes light up over little thoughtful details, the kindness you carry without even trying, and how simply talking with you turns any ordinary evening into my favourite memory.

Never stop being the magic in my world.

letters.title: A Secret Promise Under the Stars
letters.body:
You explored far enough to unlock this hidden parchment!

Promise: No matter how many seasons pass, I will always keep finding new ways to make you smile, celebrate you, and remind you that you are my once-in-a-lifetime princess.

diaryEntries.title: The Day the Kingdom Opened
diaryEntries.content: Every spire was painted in blush pink and champagne gold, waiting for Akuu to step through the castle gates.
diaryEntries.author: Tarun

diaryEntries.title: A Note for Quiet Mornings
diaryEntries.content: Remember to drink warm tea, pet Mochi the kitten, and never forget how cherished you are every single day.
diaryEntries.author: Tarun

compliments: Your smile turns even the cloudiest afternoon into rosewater sunlight.
Your kindness makes everyone around you feel quietly safe and treasured.
The way you get excited about little cute things is the sweetest magic in the world.
You carry grace without effort and warmth without measure.
Even in a room full of stars, you are the brightest light there.
Your laugh is my favourite melody in the entire kingdom.
You deserve gentleness, patience, and every beautiful fairytale dream.
Being loved by you feels like coming home to a sunlit castle.
